title: Private Desert Compound w/ pickle-ball, heated
description:
Welcome to your Scottsdale oasis, Rancho Haven, where luxury meets comfort in a sprawling estate. This property offers seven well-appointed bedrooms, including a Casita with privacy. Relax in the heated pool, hot tub, or challenge on our professional-style pickleball court, complete with basketball facilities.

 The space 
The home is outfitted with a high-tech theater for movie enthusiasts and a vibrant game room stocked with a pool table and an arcade-style golf simulator. Outdoors, the space transforms with a professional barbecue setup and multiple seating areas, including a gazebo with a gas fireplace, perfect for evening gatherings. The landscape offers breathtaking views of both the mountains and the city skyline, enhancing your stay with a sense of serenity and exclusivity.

Indoors, discover a blend of modern design and cozy touches, with each bedroom featuring top-notch amenities and entertainment options. Whether you're putting your feet up in the wine lounge or challenging friends to ping-pong in the Arizona room, every corner of Rancho Haven is crafted to elevate your stay.

Embrace the charm of Scottsdale with easy access to its renowned attractions, including prestigious golf courses, vibrant nightlife, and cultural hotspots. Just minutes from essential shopping and dining, as well as outdoor adventures like hiking at McDowell Mountain, Rancho Haven offers both the tranquility of a private retreat and the convenience of city living. Located at the intersection of N 124th St and E Shea Blvd, your ultimate getaway awaits at Rancho Haven, where every detail is curated for your enjoyment and comfort.

-----

Smoking is not allowed on this property. Cigars are OK, outside ONLY. Violating this policy will result in forfeiture of the full security deposit and guests will be liable for the full cost of damage resulting from it.
